description: This file defines the class SyncInboundEmailAccountsSubActionHandler, which manages sub-actions related to syncing inbound email accounts in SuiteCRM, including handling IMAP connections, fetching email headers, and updating email records.

classes.name: SyncInboundEmailAccountsSubActionHandler
classes.description: Handles sub-actions for syncing inbound email accounts, including index display and synchronization processes, IMAP interactions, and error handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the handler, determines sub-action, and executes corresponding method with error handling.

methods.name: getRequestedSubAction
methods.description: Retrieves the sub-action method requested via $_REQUEST['method'], defaults to 'index'.

methods.name: action_Index
methods.description: Displays the main form with inbound email account data.

methods.name: getInboundEmailRows
methods.description: Fetches all active, non-deleted inbound email accounts from the database.

methods.name: getEmailBean
methods.description: Retrieves an Email bean by ID.

methods.name: getInboundEmailBean
methods.description: Retrieves an InboundEmail bean by ID.

methods.name: action_Sync
methods.description: Performs synchronization of inbound emails, including IMAP connection, email header fetching, and record updating.

methods.name: handleIMAPErrors
methods.description: Checks and logs IMAP errors and warnings.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes the output file if it exists.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Appends a message to the output file, throws exception on failure.

methods.name: getIMAPUID
methods.description: Finds the IMAP UID matching a message ID MD5.

methods.name: getEmailIdsOfInboundEmail
methods.description: Retrieves email IDs associated with an inbound email account, validating the ID.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Executes a SQL query and returns results, throws if no results.

methods.name: getEmailHeadersOfIMAPServer
methods.description: Connects to IMAP server, fetches email headers, computes message ID MD5s, and closes connection.

methods.name: getCompoundMessageIdMD5
methods.description: Generates a compound MD5 hash of message ID and delivery info from email headers.

methods.name: isOrphanedEmail
methods.description: Determines if an email is orphaned based on IMAP headers.

methods.name: getRequestedInboundEmailAccounts
methods.description: Returns selected inbound email account IDs from request, defaults to all if none selected.
